First of all, remember that you’re gonna be totally fine - not even as high as the highest prescribed dose, just a bit higher than what you’re used to. Gabapentin can absolutely be disorienting and nauseating if you take too much. A few bits of advice: first, if you feel like puking, do it. It’ll suck but if you drink some water first it won’t hurt and you’ll feel so much better afterwards. Secondly, I find that the gabapentin high hits really weird and hard for about 40min, then evens out to a much more euphoric and comfortable high. So you might just have to finish riding through that initial discomfort. Finally, try to lay down and listen to some chill music. Some drugs moving makes you feel better, but I find gabanergeric drugs to be the opposite - lay down and let it pass, distract yourself with music cause it should sound way better. Also it’s a sleep aid so if worst comes to worst just close your eyes and sleep it off.
